summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Jane's Addiction, an American rock band formed in Los Angeles in 1985. It identifies the band's four members: vocalist Perry Farrell, guitarist Dave Navarro, drummer Stephen Perkins and bassist Chris Chaney.
